;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Venezuela]]
**Through [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Worship|Argentine Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Jorge Faurie]], the [[Lima Group]] say that "the use of force in Venezuela will be implemented when required". [http://www.el-nacional.com/noticias/mundo/grupo-lima-uso-fuerza-venezuela-sera-cuando-requiera_289639 (''El Nacional'')]
*[[Hezbollah foreign relations]]
**[[Hezbollah]] condemns [[Argentina]] over its designation of their group as a "terrorist organization", saying Argentina did so under "United States pressure". [https://itongadol.com/causa-amia/desde-hezbollah-aseguran-que-argentina-los-designo-como-organizacion-terrorista-por-presion-de-los-estados-unidos (Itón Gadol)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election]]
**[[Boris Johnson]] is elected as [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|Leader of the UK Conservative Party]], and as a result is expected to become [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom]] on 24 July 2019. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-49084605 (BBC)]
